2. Compactness theorems                                      
                    The compactness theorems presented in Chapter 2 are not sufficient for the
                 nonlinear evolution problems. Our goal now is to prove some compactness theorems
                 which are appropriate for the nonlinear problems of the remainder of this chapter.
                    After a preliminary result given in Section 2.1, we prove in Section 2.2 a com-
                 pactness theorem in the frame of Banach spaces. In Section 2.3 we prove two  
                 other compactness theorems in the frame of Hilbert spaces; one of them involves
                 fractional derivatives in time of the functions.                             
                    Some related discrete forms of these theorems will be studied later on.
